const (
	CompactionSucceeded CompactionStatus = "compacted"
	CompactionFailed    CompactionStatus = "failed"

	CompactionSkipped CompactionStatus = "skipped"

	SummaryCorrupt CompactionStatus = "summary_corrupt"
)

const (
	PendingUnread     PendingStatus = "unread"
	PendingCommitting PendingStatus = "committing"
	PendingCommitted  PendingStatus = "committed"
	PendingUnknown    PendingStatus = "commit_unknown"
)

const (
	TriggerAutomatic CompactionTrigger = "auto"
	TriggerManual    CompactionTrigger = "manual"
	TriggerOverflow  CompactionTrigger = "overflow"
)

const DefaultContextWindow = 128_000

type BoundChildTool struct {
	Tool abi.Tool

	Plugin          core.Plugin
	Close           func(context.Context) error
	CleanupComplete func() bool

	Next ChildToolBinder
}

type Builder struct {
}

type ChildBinding struct {
	ParentID, SessionID, Workspace string
	References                     agentcontext.ReferenceBackend
	Guard                          *security.Guard
}

type ChildStorage interface {
	SessionStorage
	storage.Children
}

type ChildToolBinder func(context.Context, ChildBinding) (BoundChildTool, error)

type ChildToolBinding struct {
	Parent abi.Tool
	Bind   ChildToolBinder
}

type CompactionConfig struct {
	WindowTokens     int
	TriggerRatio     float64
	KeepRecentRatio  float64
	SummaryMaxTokens int

	Force    bool
	Disabled bool

	Report func(context.Context, ContextReport) error
}

type CompactionReport struct {
	Status                        CompactionStatus
	Trigger                       CompactionTrigger
	FromSequence, ThroughSequence uint64
	Messages                      int
	Record                        *abi.RecordReference
	Usage                         *wire.Usage
	Error                         string
}

type CompactionStatus string

type CompactionTrigger string

type ContextParts struct{ System, Tools, Summary, Recent uint64 }

type ContextReport struct {
	Usage      *ContextUsage
	Compaction *CompactionReport
}

type ContextRetrievalPlugin struct {
}

type ContextUsage struct {
	InputTokens       uint64
	OutputTokens      uint64
	CachedInputTokens *uint64

	WindowTokens uint64
	Parts        *ContextParts
}

type MemoryPlugin struct{}

type NativeChildConfig struct {
	Repository           ChildStorage
	Owner, ParentID, Cwd string
	Guard                *security.Guard
	Bindings             []ChildToolBinding
	Locks                *core.ToolLockRegistry
	ToolTimeout          time.Duration
}

type NativeChildFactory struct{}

type PendingMessage struct {
	ID          string        `json:"id"`
	Text        string        `json:"text"`
	RunID       string        `json:"run_id"`
	CreatedAt   time.Time     `json:"created_at"`
	CommittedAt *time.Time    `json:"committed_at,omitempty"`
	Status      PendingStatus `json:"status"`
	Notice      string        `json:"notice,omitempty"`
}

type PendingPlugin struct{}

type PendingService struct {
}

type PendingStatus string

type Runner interface {
	Run(context.Context, []wire.Message, func(abi.Event) error) error
}

type SessionOption func(*sessionOptions)

type SessionStorage interface {
	storage.SessionReader
	storage.RecordRetention
	storage.Runs
	storage.Records
	storage.Conversations
	storage.References

	storage.ArtifactReader
}

type SystemContextPlugin struct{}

var ErrPendingCommitting = errors.New("pending message is being committed; it cannot be retracted")

var ErrPendingFull = errors.New("pending message count or byte budget exceeded")

var ErrPendingInactive = errors.New("pending messages require an active bound run")
